what: Claims written or kept to check the audit against a known answer, replayed with `npm run eval:audit -- eval/audit-controls.json`. Each says what it should get. The expectations were fixed before any of these met the audit, and are not edited after a run.
rule: What a line is and what a change did to it is checked against the code and the patch. Why is checked against a collected source. A sentence that mixes the two has to hold on both.

controls.kind: true of the code and backed by a source
controls.text: This line was added as part of a JSDoc comment documenting the new XSRF‑token‑whitelisting feature introduced in commit 1e90d03.
controls.why: Kept claim. The line is `* @example` in a doc comment the commit added; the commit message states the feature.

controls.kind: true of the code and backed by a source
controls.text: This line was added as part of a documentation block that provides an example for the newly introduced XSRF‑token whitelisting feature in $http.
controls.why: Kept claim, the other wording of the same answer.

controls.kind: true of the code and backed by a source
controls.text: The line was rewritten to pass the path through path.resolve by pull request #4887, which adds path.resolve when fs.writeFileSync is called with a temp file path, to fix writing temp files on macOS 10.15.
controls.why: The patch shows the rewrite; the pull request states both the change and the bug.

controls.kind: true of the code and backed by a source
controls.text: The declaration was rewritten from var to const by commit 8de2db9, which changed the remaining vars in Draft.js to let/const because var was triggering the author’s OCD.
controls.why: The patch shows var becoming const; the commit states the sweep and its reason.

controls.kind: true of the code and backed by a source
controls.text: The condition was rewritten from `!== undefined` to `=== undefined` by commit 8b853b2, a cleanup and refactoring of the rule and formatter loaders.
controls.why: An incidental line described without a borrowed motive: the patch shows the rewrite, the commit title names the cleanup.

controls.kind: true of the code and backed by a source
controls.text: The delay was rewritten to add jitter by commit 0016d9d, which stops recovering clients from retrying in lockstep after an outage.
controls.why: Synthetic. The patch shows the rewrite; the commit states the reason.

controls.kind: says something the code or the patch contradicts
controls.text: The line at src/ng/http.js:411 implements the whitelist check, so the XSRF token header is attached only when the request URL matches one of the whitelisted origins.
controls.why: Kept claim, credited in every run before the line was shown. The line is `* @example`.

controls.kind: says something the code or the patch contradicts
controls.text: The line was added to implement support for sending the XSRF token to whitelisted origins, because normally the token is omitted for cross‑origin requests.
controls.why: Kept claim, the commonest wording. A doc comment implements nothing.

controls.kind: says something the code or the patch contradicts
controls.text: The line was rewritten to call path.resolve instead of the now‑deprecated getRelativePath function.
controls.why: Kept claim. The line is `if (Formatter === undefined) {` and read `if (Formatter !== undefined) {` before. Neither calls path.resolve.
